messages:
maria.docs: Hey team — opening a docs PR to update the Osprey2B model card. Need a quick sweep for limits, migration notes, and an SDK v4 streaming embeddings snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2489

sam.eng: Taking a look. Main engineering notes: osprey2b-quant-8bit has a different seqlen profile. We should call out seq ceiling at 16k tokens for quantized variants and 32k for float32. Also note sustained throughput drops at batch >8 for 16k+ contexts.

lee.research: Benchmarks uploaded: https://bench.internal/redwood/osprey2b/2026-03 — 8-bit perf numbers + latency p95. Summary: float32 p95 ~110ms @512 tokens, int8 p95 ~160ms @512 tokens. I'll paste a small table in the PR.

toni.docs: I'll update the examples. Also want to add a migration checklist for customers moving from Orion to Osprey2B (minor API differences in tokenizer). Proposed checklist in PR comment.

maria.docs: @sam.eng @lee.research can you both confirm the seq ceiling wording? Also @karen-se, any security note for the Private deploy package (KMS key rotation mention)?

karen-se: No new secrets surface. Just remind to follow KMS key rotation in Private docs. We should add an audit-log example. I'll add a one-liner.

sam.eng: Confirmed re: seq ceilings. Also add runtime compatibility note: runtime >=1.9 required for streaming KV optimizations; older runtimes will fallback to non-streaming and increase latency. Suggest snippet: `runtime: ">=1.9"` in model card.

toni.docs: Draft SDK v4 streaming embeddings snippet (will add to PR):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
with client.stream_embeddings(model="osprey2b-embed-8k") as s:
    for chunk in s.generate("long document...", batch_size=4):
        # chunk is list[float] partial vectors
        print(len(chunk[0]))
```

maria.docs: Nice. Can we also include an example using the CLI for quick migration? e.g., `rw model migrate --from=orion-3b --to=osprey2b` ?

sam.eng: CLI is fine as pseudo-example but not an actual command yet. Change to `rw utils estimate-migration --src=orion-3b --dst=osprey2b` and note it's an estimate only.

build-bot: link-check: found one broken anchor in the benchmarks section: `#throughput-plot` — failing link check.

toni.docs: I'll fix anchor name and re-run.

maria.docs: OK, plan: toni fixes anchors + add SDK snippet + migration checklist; lee adds bench snapshot and table; sam adds runtime line and seq ceiling wording; karen adds audit-log one-liner. Ping here when PR updated.

lee.research: PR updated with benchmarks and a short blurb about input padding artifacts.

toni.docs: anchor fixed, snippet added, lint passed locally.

build-bot: docs-lint passed. link-check: all good.

maria.docs: Thanks everyone :tada: merging after a final 1-hour review window.
